items.title: ‘Neverness to Everness’ Version 1.4 “For Whom the Verses Mourn” Launches 30 Sept.
items.summary: Developer Hotta World and publisher Perfect World will be launching Version 1.4, dubbed "For Whom the Verses Mourn", for their free-to-play supernatural
items.content:
Developer Hotta World and publisher Perfect World will be launching Version 1.4, dubbed “For Whom the Verses Mourn”, for their free-to-play supernatural urban open-world game ‘NTE: Neverness to Everness’ on 30 September across PC (Windows/macOS/Linux via Proton), PlayStation 5, and mobile platforms . The streets of Hethereau are getting busier, as two new Porsche vehicles hit the road and the gates to Pukaland finally open, turning the previously inaccessible theme park into a new area packed with attractions, discoveries and rewards. Version 1.4 also introduces new character Blackbird, a mysterious witch who can transform into a bird and fly through the open world, and a series of new supernatural mysteries for Neverness to Everness.

Players who have spent their time in Hethereau wondering what lies beyond the gates of Pukaland will finally get their answer on September 30. Version 1.4 transforms the familiar landmark into a fully explorable theme park with four distinct zones, packed with attractions that offer their own challenges.

Start on Puka Avenue with the Pendulum, Spinning Octopus and Drop Tower, where a button-input minigame challenges players to climb even higher. Venture deeper into the park to race through Cakehill’s Flora Maze before your stamina runs out, avoid lurking inhabitants in the Spooky Cookies haunted house, or ride a roller coaster through Lavaton’s volcanic landscape.

The Wonderlog tracks activities and rewards across the park, with Puka Stars earned at attractions exchangeable for souvenirs and other items. Familiar characters will also join in the festivities along the way.

And when night falls, players can gather around Pukatopia Castle to watch fireworks illuminate the sky. Just keep an eye out: even a day at the theme park can take an unexpected turn when anomalies are involved.

Just in time for spooky season, the enigmatic witch Blackbird joins NTE’s playable roster on 30 September, alongside the return of “Ketchup Demon” Lacrimosa. Blackbird’s tale begins with a mysterious plea for help that draws the usually homebound witch out into the unknown, leaving players to uncover who needs her help and where the journey will lead. Beyond her story, Blackbird offers a distinctive new way to explore the open world. She can transform into a bird and take to the skies, while character interactions allow her to hold hands with the protagonist and even take them flying. Away from battle, these moments reveal a different side to her, with three outfits offering even more ways to showcase her personality and style.

Version 1.4 will also bring new Anomaly Commissions to Hethereau, expanding the city’s collection of strange and supernatural encounters. Players may find themselves waiting for a Ghost Bus late at night, surrounded by some unusual passengers, or searching a dream for a hidden anomaly while trying to avoid the lurking monsters. Another investigation takes an unexpected turn when everyday objects suddenly become enormous.

These new commissions will become permanent additions to Hethereau, giving players even more mysteries to uncover as they explore the city.

The second NTE × Porsche collaboration shifts into gear with two new additions: the Porsche 911 Turbo (930) and the Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package. Whether behind the wheel of the iconic 911 Turbo or the cutting-edge Taycan Turbo GT, players can take their favourite onto the streets of Hethereau and make the journey between destinations part of the experience.

The Porsche 918 Spyder also makes its return, giving players who missed the first collaboration another chance to add it to their collection.

Version 1.4 also opens the doors to the new Porsche Club, with free customisation including special liveries and performance parts, alongside exclusive furniture, titles, namecards, phone wallpapers and cases. The collaboration extends beyond the driver’s seat, offering more ways for players to bring their enthusiasm for Porsche into their lives in Hethereau.

The partnership continues the first-ever automotive brand collaboration of its kind in the anime urban RPG genre, offering players the exhilarating experience of driving a world-class luxury sports car to explore NTE’s vibrant open world in style.

Players can also look forward to a range of gifts and rewards throughout Version 1.4:

Enjoying DayOne ? Do us a favour, and make us a ‘ Preferred Source on Google ‘ – that way, you’ll only be delivered more gaming coverage from our team.

items.title: Neverness to Everness Version 1.4 preview unveils more about Blackbird, Akane Rin, and Pukaland
items.summary: Here's everything revealed for Neverness to Everness (NTE) Version 1.4.
items.content:
All News NTE Version 1.4 will introduce Blackbird and Akane Rin as playable characters (Image: Hotta Studio)

{" "} Neverness to Everness Version 1.4 preview unveils more about Blackbird, Akane Rin, and Pukaland .iframe-media {width: 100%;aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} .img-media {width: 100%;aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} .a-img-media {aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} Here's everything revealed for Neverness to Everness (NTE) Version 1.4. Neverness to Everness has unveiled a comprehensive look into its Version 1.4 titled “For Whom the Verses Mourn”, running from 30 September to 11 November. The hour-long Special Program livestream included previews of upcoming characters Blackbird and Akane Rin, plus its highly-anticipated theme park island Pukaland, and many new additions.

Version 1.4 will bring two unique stories across both halves of the update, one following Blackbird’s quest outside her Witch House, and the other a sequel to the quest where we first met Akane Rin and formed “The Whoots!!!” band with her.

Find out everything you need to know about Neverness to Everness Version 1.4 below.

The upcoming Version 1.4 will introduce two characters Appraisers are already well acquainted with. Here’s everything you need to know about Blackbird and Akane Rin:

Blackbird is a mystical and private character who resides in the Witch House, a place where Appraisers can exchange Oracle Stones for rewards, receive blessings, and more.

Players can obtain Blackbird from her limited-time Foretold Finale banner, which runs from 30 September to 21 October, alongside her designated Arc banner, “Roostfeather Special”. Meanwhile, Lacrimosa’s character and Arc banners will also receive a rerun.

In the first half of Version 1.4, Appraisers will accompany Blackbird on a quest after she receives a mysterious letter asking for her help in resolving an undisclosed issue. Rarely leaving the comfort of her Witch House, Blackbird embarks on the ominous quest without knowing the identity of the sender or any details about the problem. The quest will unlock a new location anomaly called St. Arbor.

NTE will also introduce four unique outfits for Blackbird after her banner release. In addition to the Loungewear outfit, Appraisers can obtain Wandering Stars from the Mall, Unfazed Denim by reaching Bond Level 10, and Rouge et Noir by accumulating 200 rolls in the Skin Perks event.

In the quest “A Legendary (?) Band’s First Page”, Appraisers teamed up with Haniel and Nanally to form a band called THE WHOOTS!!!, during which players first met Akane Rin. In the quest, she eventually became the band’s lead singer and guitarist.

In Version 1.4, Akane Rin will finally become playable, with players able to obtain her from the limited-time “Dazzling Star” banner, which runs from 21 October to 11 November. Her exclusive Arc banner, “Celestial Special”, will also run at the same time.

In the second half of the update, players will receive a sequel to their first encounter with Akane Rin through a new quest entitled “To Us, Back Then”. The band will return to the stage for Clement Academy’s Centennial celebration, while the quest will also offer a deeper look into Akane’s past and her former band.

Her release will also come with four unique outfits. Appraisers can obtain the Cozy Velvet and Full Metal Rock outfits from the Mall, Off the Clock by reaching Bond Level 10, and Shining Idol by accumulating 200 rolls in the Skin Perks event.

Appraisers who have spent enough time exploring the open world may have already stumbled upon the restricted entrance to Pukaland. Well, with Version 1.4, the highly anticipated ginormous theme park is finally set to open.

items.title: Neverness to Everness Hosts Version 1.4 Special Broadcast, Teases Porsche Collaboration
items.summary: ©Perfect World, Hotta StudioNeverness to Everness, the supernatural urban open-world RPG developed by Perfect World's Hotta Studio, drew widespread attention during its Version 1.4...
items.content:
New Region Puka Paradise Revealed alongside Half-Anniversary Rewards

Korean (한국어) KO Add us on ©Perfect World, Hotta Studio Neverness to Everness, the supernatural urban open-world RPG developed by Perfect World's Hotta Studio, drew widespread attention during its Version 1.4 special broadcast on September 16, revealing a new region, two new characters, and half-anniversary events marking five months since launch.

The centerpiece of the Version 1.4 update is Puka Paradise, a massive theme park occupying an entire island styled like a giant amusement park. In this new region, players can enjoy a variety of minigames and rides, with thrilling attractions like a Haunted House alongside overlapping Anomaly incidents delivering a unique experience.

Details about the characters joining the roster were also covered in depth. Set to officially launch on September 30, the S-Rank character Raven worked as a fortune teller at the Witch's House and possesses a fast-cycle trait alongside Chaos-attribute Esper abilities. Later in the second half of Version 1.4, S-Rank character Akane Rin, a band member working part-time at the StarSign live house, will be added. Akane Rin was previously introduced to players in the side story 'First Page of a Legendary Band'.

Alongside the arrival of these new characters, the storyline will also expand. The second half will unlock 'To Us of That Day', a continuation of the side story, featuring a new collaboration song that builds on the emotional weight of the ongoing narrative. In addition, a second Porsche collaboration was confirmed, giving players the opportunity to open Blind Boxes to obtain a new collaboration vehicle.

To commemorate five months since its official launch, Neverness to Everness is offering a wealth of special rewards. Alongside the Season Gift check-in event that accompanies major version updates, special half-anniversary rewards for the Puka Festival have been prepared. Upon logging into the game after completing the Version 1.4 update, players will immediately receive 10 Dice of Truth.

The broadcast concluded on a warm note with a special message from the character voice actors to players. Over the past five months, Neverness to Everness has maintained active communication with its community by consistently holding preview streams for every version to introduce new regions and varied stories. Further details on this update, which previews the new journey ahead, can be found on the official website and game lounge.

items.title: Neverness to Everness (NTE) Review: Not Perfect, But Promising
Neverness To Everness Said To Be The Culprit For Two Alienware Gaming Laptops Failing, Both Machines Ended Up With Corrupted EC Chips That Required Reprogramming
items.summary: Neverness To Everness is reportedly causing severe hardware failures on Alienware gaming laptops by corrupting their EC chips and requiring manual re-programming
items.content:
The Alienware m17 R4 and the Alienware m15 R3 both suffered from a hardware failure a few days after their users began playing “Neverness To Everness” on them. Now, it may seem strange that a game would be responsible for this behavior, but a repair expert shows that both machines have shown the exact same symptom: the EC (Embedded Controller) chip getting corrupted, requiring the reprogramming of both parts that restored functionality.

A gaming laptop’s EC chip is pretty much the heart of the machine and controls nearly every aspect, right down to telling the hardware to power on when the power button is pressed to have it fail means you’ve more or less bricked your laptop, and it will need to be sent for either a warranty claim or repair job The Parts-People Dell Laptop Experts YouTube channel notes that both Alienware gaming laptops died in the exact same fashion and decided to investigate.

Sure enough, after checking various parameters, the repair expert moved to the EC chip, and after reprogramming the Alienware m17 R4, it finally showed power, but no picture was shown on the screen. Connecting a test screen revealed that the panel had stopped working, but it wasn’t concluded whether Neverness To Everness was responsible for this failure, too. As for the second repair job, the Alienware m15 R3 also went through an EC chip reprogramming. The only difference here is that the display was working perfectly.

Strangely, as skilled as the repair expert is in diagnosing the problem and addressing it, he still doesn’t believe that Neverness To Everness could have been responsible for these Alienware gaming laptops' malfunctioning. Instead, he concludes that overheating and power spikes resulted in hardware failure. Then again, why would the EC chips get corrupted if it were an overheating issue?

Digging around the YouTube comments, we noticed that one individual mentioned that Neverness To Everness employs kernel-level anti-cheat, which is software that’s running at the deepest level of the operating system. Now, we’ve personally encountered problems running kernel-level anti-cheat software like Easy Anti-Cheat when playing “Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2” multiplayer through Steam.

Upon firing up the game, our gaming laptop would crash with a BSOD. When we investigated the matter, we realized that a system driver installed by Easy Anti-Cheat in our “C” drive was causing our computer to crash. As a result, we used Windows 11’s Task Scheduler to automatically delete this specific file every time the gaming laptop is powered on. Thankfully, the problem hasn’t materialized after this fix was applied.

While we were fortunate enough to pinpoint the issue, the two Alienware gaming laptop owners weren’t so lucky, and when you’re using kernel-level anti-cheat software, this can happen to you, too.

About the author : Omar Sohail is a reporter and analyst for Wccftech's mobile section, specializing in the technology and business of the mobile industry. His expertise lies in the intricate hardware supply chain, covering developments in semiconductor manufacturing, chip lithography, and camera sensor technology.

items.title: NTE Steam Login FAQ
items.summary: Hey, Appraisers! On \[08/19/2026], NTE will be adding Steam account login support. If you're a new player, you can simply log in with Steam to jump right into the game. If you're an existing player with game progress and want to link that t
items.content:
Hey, Appraisers!

On \[08/19/2026], NTE will be adding Steam account login support. If you're a new player, you can simply log in with Steam to jump right into the game. If you're an existing player with game progress and want to link that to your Steam account, be sure to log in to NTE using your existing game account first, and then go to \ > \ to link your Steam account.

We've also put together a list of FAQs below for your reference. If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out to Customer Support at nte.contactus@perfectworld.com.

Q: I've already logged in to NTE using my Steam account. Can I still link another game account that already has progress?

A: No. Logging in with a Steam account automatically creates a brand-new User ID, and that Steam account can't be linked to another game account with existing progress.

Q: If I play on Steam with my Steam account, can I continue playing on other platforms?

A: Yes. After you link your Steam account to an email address in the User Center, you can use that email to log in on other platforms and keep your game progress synced.

Q: My Steam account is linked to an email address / Facebook / Google. Can I unlink them later?

A: You can unlink third-party login accounts like Facebook, Google, and Steam in the User Center. Email accounts cannot be unlinked. Please proceed with care.

Q: If I unlink a Steam account from my email account, which account keeps the game progress?

A: Once the unlinking is complete, your character progress will remain with your email account.

Q: Can I link a Steam account on mobile or other clients?

A: No. Currently, only the Steam game client supports Steam account login and linking.

Q: Can an unlinked Steam account be linked to a different game account?

A: Yes. Once unlinked, your Steam account returns to an unused state and is ready to be linked to another NTE game account that isn't already linked to Steam. The process still follows the same order: log in to the target game account first, then link Steam.

items.summary: Hey Appraiser, NTE will undergo version maintenance on August 19, 2026 from 06:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). Once it's done, the all-new Version 1.3 "Rising from the Moonlit Fog" goes live. "Pink Paws Heist" will be temporarily unavailable starting
items.content:
Hey Appraiser,

NTE will undergo version maintenance on August 19, 2026 from 06:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). Once it's done, the all-new Version 1.3 "Rising from the Moonlit Fog" goes live. "Pink Paws Heist" will be temporarily unavailable starting August 19 at 05:30 (UTC+8) and will reopen once maintenance wraps up.

Login will be unavailable during this period, so please plan accordingly. Since this update is on the larger side, we recommend using Wi-Fi or mobile data to complete the download. We apologize for any inconvenience!

※ "The Lifeline" Limited Board ends on August 19, 2026, at 05:59 (UTC+8). Be sure to head to the Wayfarer Perks page and redeem your rewards before then.

\

● Duration: August 19, 2026, 06:00–11:00 (UTC+8)

● Maintenance Compensation: Annulith x300

● Eligibility: Appraisers who created their character before August 19, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8)

● Distribution: Sent via in-game mail after maintenance. Remember to claim the items before they expire.

※Maintenance may end earlier or later than scheduled depending on actual progress. Please keep an eye on our official announcements for updates.

● Eligibility: Appraisers who created their character before August 19, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8)

◆ Added tag categories for posts on Bagel SNS.

◆ Added a confirmation popup when gifting "A Handwritten Letter".

◆ Added a minimap to "Pink Paws Heist".

◆ Added "Shadow Sweep" tracking in multiplayer.

◆ Added passenger orders for new locations to "Swift Cab" and updated the voice lines for unhappy passengers.

◆ Added delivery orders for new locations to "City Delivery".

◆ "City Delivery" now supports Auto-Drive.

◆ Added multiple new racetracks to "Races - Online".

◆ Added a quick-lock feature to the "Sea Angler" fish tank screen.

◆ On the "Sea Angler" catch results screen, you can now press F to jump straight back into fishing.

◆ Photo Mode can now be used while driving or swimming.

◆ Added the F7 shortcut key to hide in-game UI with a single press (currently PC only).

◆ Improved City Tycoon Lvl 16 Perk: City Stamina consumption speed increased from 100% to 200%.

◆ Farm produce can now be sold by spending City Stamina. You can grow crops by farming at "Stillmeadow House".

◆ Added an aim assist toggle under Settings - Control.

◆ Shinku can now perform interactions while in "Surging Crimson" or the hold-dodge special movement state, which instantly ends her transformed state.

◆ Improved the visual effects for Chaos's dodge.

◆ Improved the visuals of Shinku's 5th Basic Attack hit when the target is off-balance.

◆ In "999 Nights", the maximum amount of gear that can be recycled at once has been raised to 50.

◆ Various quality-of-life improvements to "999 Nights".

◆ Improved character rendering.

◆ Character info can now be shared on Bagel SNS.

◆ Fixed an issue where recolored outfits did not display correctly on passenger-seat companions and characters hired at "The Cafe by Origen".

◆ Fixed an issue where Shinku's wall climbing animations could play incorrectly while she's in the hold-dodge special movement state.

◆ Fixed an issue where Jiuyuan's animations could play incorrectly when leaving the battlefield after being hit.

◆ Fixed an issue where Shinku's "Instant Strike" could drop damage against multiple targets while "Snowfall Slope" was active.

◆ Fixed an issue where Shinku's stamina could drain at abnormal rates in certain cases when entering the hold-dodge special movement state.

◆ Fixed an issue where Hotori did not gain "Defiant Spirit" when spending stacks of "Menacing Gaze" while recording and replaying Shinku's Skills.

◆ Fixed an issue in the Bagel notification settings screen where pressing \ caused other settings to display incorrectly.

◆ Fixed an issue on some mobile devices, where vehicle controls could not be customized.

◆ Fixed an issue in controller mode where the Term Notes screen for character Esper Abilities could not scroll.

◆ Fixed crashes that could occur in certain situations.

◆ Improved localization for several languages.

◆ Fixed other known issues.

items.title: “Each ability feels like it could have been the central mechanic of its own game.” We ask a fellow developer what makes NTE: Neverness to Everness so impressive
items.summary: Indie-Us-Games CEO Masahiko Nakamura talks about the the strengths of NTE: Neverness to Everness from a dev's perspective.
items.content:
Home Game Development “Each ability feels like it could have been the central mechanic of its own game.” We ask a fellow developer what makes NTE: Neverness to Everness so impressive Indie-Us-Games CEO Masahiko Nakamura talks about the the strengths of NTE: Neverness to Everness from a dev's perspective.

Column , Game Development 2026-07-09 22:00 AUTOMATON WEST 2 Earlier this year, Perfect World Games released NTE: Neverness to Everness (hereafter NTE), a free-to-play open-world action RPG where players track down and contain supernatural “Anomalies” scattered across an urban setting. The game comes with a colorful cast of playable characters who, beyond differing appearances and stats, offer unique abilities like gravity manipulation or skill copying, fundamentally changing the way combat and exploration play out.

The title has also attracted attention for its vast cityscapes built in Unreal Engine 5 and reality-warping Anomaly scenes. Hoping to learn more about what makes NTE impressive from a technical point of view, AUTOMATON Japan recently spoke with Masahiko Nakamura, technical artist and head of Indie-us Games, a studio specializing in Unreal Engine development. In this installment, we focus on the technical ingenuity behind NTE’s character abilities and visual effects.

—I believe one of NTE’s stand-out features is its unique character abilities, but was there anything that stood out to you technically in this respect?

Nakamura: The signature abilities of the featured characters so far, such as Nanally’s gravity manipulation, Xun’s time stop, and Lacrimosa’s copy ability, have really stood out to me.

I think these are the kind of core mechanics that, in any other game, would be considered the “selling point” which the whole game is built upon. And yet, in NTE, they’re all introduced as individual abilities of specific characters.

What’s more, not only are features like these difficult to implement, but they also come with extremely high debugging costs. For example, Nanally’s gravity control isn’t particularly extraordinary in itself, given that Unreal Engine already has a Custom Gravity feature, but NTE’s world is packed with objects, and players have a great deal of freedom to move around. Once you start changing the direction of gravity in that kind of environment, it’s impossible to predict what all could happen.

In fact, there was actually a bug that caused players to be launched into the air due to gravity behaving incorrectly, which got patched out in an update. I imagine the developers fully expected issues like that to crop up. Even so, the game gives me the impression that the team went, “It’s fun, so let’s do it, bugs be damned.” I find it impressive that they made a feature that’s inherently so trouble-prone one of the game’s stand-out mechanics.

—Do you think the high risk of bugs would make many developers shy away from that kind of feature?

Nakamura: Yes. Even if you can anticipate problems, the cost of actually debugging them can be astronomical. But with NTE, I get the feeling they’ve simply resigned themselves to that reality (laughs) .

The time-stop ability is another feature that can be a headache. In Unreal Engine, things running on the CPU are relatively easy to “pause,” but effects running on the GPU aren’t. If you stop time in NTE, you’ll notice that the wind and ocean waves continue moving, but rain and snow do not. The developers cleverly create an illusion of stopped time by removing the original particle effects and swapping in separate ones showing static raindrops or snowflakes.

—That sounds like something only a fellow engineer would notice.

Nakamura: Most players probably wouldn’t think twice about it, but from a developer’s perspective, the difference between what’s moving and what’s stopped is quite stark. If QA filed a bug saying, “This doesn’t stop when time freezes,” I’d probably respond, “I really don’t want to fix that” because of how much work it is (laughs).

Lacrimosa’s copy ability is also an ambitious feature. It basically works like Kirby’s copy ability, which means the more enemy types you add, the more abilities you have to implement. Every new enemy requires another unique ability, so it essentially creates an endless workload.
